title: Surreal Painting Ritual
description: A woman in a bronze gown kneels on the debris-strewn floor of a ruined room, reaching toward a large surreal painting on an easel. The painting depicts a woman's face split between beauty and decay, with green slime dripping from the frame onto scattered film reels labeled 'FEATURE REEL' and 'STATUS LOCKED FUSION'.
prompt: A cinematic surreal scene inside a decaying room with broken windows showing a desert wasteland at dusk. A woman in a flowing bronze satin gown kneels on a cracked wooden floor covered in debris, reaching toward a large ornate painting on an easel. The painting shows a beautiful woman's face half-covered in circuitry and melting into a post-apocalyptic desert with a mushroom cloud. Green slime drips heavily from the painting frame. Scattered film reels on the floor read 'FEATURE REEL' and 'STATUS LOCKED FUSION'. Chandelier overhead, cinematic lighting, highly detailed, surreal atmosphere.
